It was one of the first playzones in the area so it was a rage. But now with the new zones emerging this space may fall behind.

They have quite a few activities - slides, ball pit, car zoom, swings, wall climbing trampoline etc but it's sadly not maintained. Thought it's not "unclean" the broken ball pit, crumbling sponge does make your heart jitter a bit.

I visited Bhingari in Virar with four friends, and right at the entrance we were asked to pay ₹1000 per person as a deposit (₹4000 total). This policy itself felt unusual, but we agreed.

When we went upstairs, the ambience was extremely chaotic with very loud music playing. Since we wanted to talk among ourselves, we chose a table far from the speakers. Despite the restaurant being mostly empty (only 3–4 tables occupied), the management asked us to vacate that table saying it was “reserved” and forced us to sit near the loud music.

We politely requested them to lower the volume, but they refused. We then asked to be seated in the family section. They agreed—but shockingly informed us that ₹500 would be deducted from our deposit because of this change.

Frustrated, we decided to leave and requested a refund of our deposit. That’s when we were told ₹500 would still be deducted. It became clear that the “deposit” is structured in a way that if customers decide to leave due to discomfort, ₹500 is automatically cut.

This feels less like a policy and more like a money-making trap. Extremely unprofessional management, poor customer handling, and zero flexibility despite the restaurant being nearly empty.

A horrible experience overall. We will never visit again and strongly advise others to be cautious about this deposit policy.

Efficient Billing (Usually): While queues can be long, the number of billing counters and the staff's general speed is often noted as efficient.

Crowding and Congestion: This is the most frequent complaint. Stores are often heavily crowded, especially on weekends and during peak hours, leading to long queues and difficulty moving around.
Staff Behavior and Customer Service: A significant number of recent reviews mention impolite, unhelpful, or rude staff, poor management, and a lack of proper customer assistance.
Parking Issues: Limited or congested parking space is a common problem at many locations.
Out-of-Stock Items: Some users report that certain popular items are frequently out of stock, and restocking is slow.
Pricing/Billing Errors: Occasional issues are reported with incorrect pricing displayed on shelves versus the billed price, which can take time to resolve.
Product Quality (Non-Grocery): While groceries are generally well-received, some customers suggest the quality of non-essential items like low-priced apparel or cheap durable goods can be mediocre.
